brand.name: My Dealer
brand.tagline: We want to be your dealer.
brand.blurb: A founder-built adult-use cannabis shop. Real Minnesota cannabis, grown as cannabis. Licensed in Bayport.
brand.logoAlt: My Dealer cartoon head logo with hat and glasses
brand._src: home header/footer; logo alt from the home page

announcement.text: Veterans and active military: 15% off every day. Andersen employees: 10% off every Tuesday. Valid ID required, ask your budtender at checkout.

store.name: My Dealer Bayport
store.hours: Noon to 8 pm, 7 days a week. Longer hours are on the way.
store.hoursShort: Open noon to 8 daily. Longer hours are on the way.
store.licenseLine: Licensed by the Minnesota Office of Cannabis Management. Cannabis Retailer License DIS-L24-000241. 243 3rd Street North, Bayport, MN 55003.
store.type: Licensed adult-use (recreational) cannabis dispensary. Adult-use retail only; not a medical cannabis dispensary.
store.age: 21+ only, with valid ID, every visit.
store.orderAhead: Order ahead online at https://mydealermn.com/bayport and pick up in store the same day or the next day. You pay when you pick up, and bring your ID. Orders not picked up by the end of the next day go back into inventory.
store.payment: Cash, or debit card through the cashless ATM. No credit cards.
store.atm: My Dealer takes cash, or your debit card through the cashless ATM. There is also a regular ATM on site. The cashless ATM has a $3 fee and runs in $10 steps, so your withdrawal rounds up to the nearest $10 and you get the difference back in cash.
store.parking: The building has entrances at both the front and the back. There's a paved lot behind the building: turn onto 1st Ave N, then take a left down the alley. There's also street parking out front on 3rd Street (Highway 95), and a public lot at City Hall across the street.
store.landmarks: Next to the post office and the American Legion. Across from city hall and the police station. The sign sits flat on the brick, so look for the face with the hat. Bayport goes by fast.

fromNorth.label: From the north
fromNorth.text: Stillwater / Bayport exit (MN-95), then about 2 minutes south on Highway 95. Store is on your left.

fromSouth.label: From the south
fromSouth.text: Exit 258 Stillwater, then about 4 miles north on Highway 95. Store is on your right.

store.delivery: Not right now. Everything is in-store or preorder for pickup.
store.consumption: No. There is no on-site consumption, and Minnesota law doesn't allow cannabis use in a motor vehicle, parked or moving. Bayport bans smoking or vaping cannabis in public places, including the store's lot.
store.app: Not yet. A My Dealer customer app is coming soon. Until then, use https://mydealermn.com/bayport to order ahead.
store.medical: No. My Dealer is an adult-use store for adults 21 and older. Staff don't give medical advice.
store.limits: Up to 2 ounces of flower, 8 grams of concentrate (vapes count here), and 800 mg of THC in edibles (shared across cannabis edibles, hemp edibles, and hemp THC drinks) per purchase.
store.sells: Deli flower (weighed at the counter, priced by the gram), packaged flower (pre-packs), pre-rolls, vapes and carts, THC edibles, hemp edibles, hemp THC beverages, hemp topicals, cannabis seeds, and accessories. The menu changes with each batch; check https://mydealermn.com/bayport for what's on the shelf today.
store.chain: No. It's one locally owned store, built mostly by founder Brandon Van Asten, who won a Minnesota social-equity retail license. Wabasha, MN is planned as the second store: property is secured, build-out still to come.
store.bbbAlt: My Dealer LLC BBB Business Review

discounts.title: Veterans and active military
discounts.text: Veterans and active military get 15% off the entire order every day, in store or order ahead, with a valid military or veteran ID. It can't be combined with other discounts; you automatically get the single best discount for your cart.

discounts.title: Andersen employees
discounts.text: Andersen employees get 10% off every Tuesday with a valid Andersen ID. Discounts don't stack unless a promo says it does.

rewards.text: Sign up with your phone number and earn 3% back in points on purchases, plus member deals. Nearly all promotions are for members only.
rewards._src: llms-full.txt Q 'Is there a rewards or loyalty program?'

brandsCarried.intro: Brands on the live menu include Vireo, RYTHM, Dogwalkers, Good Green, Campfire Cannabis, and Trawa. The lineup changes; the live menu is the source of truth.
brandsCarried._src: llms-full.txt Q 'What brands does My Dealer carry?'

deliFlower.intro: Deli flower is weighed at the counter. Prices as of October 22, 2026 (check the live menu for current prices). You can mix and match strains within a price tier.
